urls.title: Pages to check
urls.description: Pages whose links should be checked (up to 1,000 per run). Tip: use a sitemap extractor's output to check a whole site.

onlyBroken.title: Only return broken links
onlyBroken.description: Hide working links from the results (they are still checked and counted).

includeAssets.title: Also check images, scripts and stylesheets

respectRobotsTxt.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobotsTxt.description: Skip pages and links the site asks bots not to fetch. Turn off only for your own sites.
